## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] I used only synthetic or explicitly authorized fixtures.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, local `.env` files, customer data, generated
      SARIF, databases, or build artifacts.
- [ ] I documented trust-boundary, evidence-contract, schema, rule-DSL, API, or
      migration effects, or marked them not applicable.
- [ ] New detections include a true-positive fixture and close negative cases.
- [ ] Static candidates, runtime observations, and exploit proof are not
      presented as equivalent evidence.

## Verification

List the exact commands and relevant results. Do not paste secrets or private
source paths.

## Reviewer notes

Call out sensitive files, generated changes, follow-up work, and known limits.
